title: Below Intelligence & Shadow Observatory — Roots, Hidden Systems, Threat Networks and Repair
purpose: Populate the Below Platform with concrete intelligence-bearing systems while separating lawful secrecy, ordinary privacy, contested classification and documented illicit harm. The observatory studies what is difficult to see and how hidden structures reproduce; it is not a universal suspicion engine.
master_definition: Below is the project's depth/intelligence platform: buried provenance, hidden or restricted information, shadow-facing systems, clandestine/illicit networks, high-risk subcultures, evidence stores and investigative processes become legible here before being verified, repaired, prosecuted, contextualized or returned upward.
critical_distinctions: Lower Manifestation Field != Below Platform. Embodiment and material reality are broader than intelligence/shadow research.
Below != evil. Roots, archives, intelligence analysis, privacy and legitimate confidential work also belong below-facing.
Intelligence agency != criminal organization. Public intelligence/security institutions and illicit networks occupy different legal/evidentiary classes even when both handle secrecy.
Secret != illicit. Classified, confidential, anonymous, private, clandestine and criminal are distinct states.
Cult/high-control descriptor != criminal conviction. Preserve classifier, methodology, jurisdiction and legal findings.
Terrorist designation is jurisdiction-specific and time-bounded.
Shadow is a visibility/integration problem; Swamp is a blocked-flow regime; Forge is a verification/transformation process.

lower_stack.function: Recover provenance, ancestry, prior states, hidden dependencies and buried evidence.
Collect, classify, correlate and assess information under uncertainty.
Expose what a declared model excludes or cannot integrate.
Map systems where opacity, extraction, conflict, jurisdictional fragmentation or blocked accountability become self-reinforcing.
Turn raw intelligence/residue into evidence-aware knowledge, adjudication, repair or rejection.

concrete_families.label: Public intelligence, security & investigative institutions
concrete_families.project_role: Below/intelligence because they collect, assess, protect or investigate information that is not fully visible from the public surface; not Swamp by default.

concrete_families.label: Private intelligence, investigation & surveillance ecosystem
concrete_families.legal_class: lawful commercial capability unless specific conduct is unlawful
concrete_families.project_role: Interface between lawful confidential work and possible misuse; capability, deployment and illegality must be separate fields.

concrete_families.label: Organized crime, gangs & prison networks
concrete_families.legal_class: criminal organization/network where established by law-enforcement/court evidence
concrete_families.project_role: Tree-of-Strife / Swamp candidates where crime, coercion, finance, recruitment and succession reproduce the network.

concrete_families.label: Human trafficking, sexual exploitation & forced-labour networks
concrete_families.project_role: Concrete Seed-of-Death reproduction model: vulnerability→recruitment→control→extraction→money→recruitment, with victims never reduced to nodes of spectacle.

concrete_families.label: Drug trafficking & illicit markets
concrete_families.project_role: Shows how a harmful foundation can become a market/community: supply, trust, enforcement, money laundering, communication and recruitment make the network repeatable.

concrete_families.label: Terrorist & violent-extremist organizations
concrete_families.project_role: Study founding ideology, recruitment, financing, branch/faction genealogy, propaganda, attacks at high level, disruption and successor networks without operational guidance.

concrete_families.label: Hate groups, high-control movements & destructive group dynamics
concrete_families.project_role: Study reproduction through doctrine, identity, initiation, isolation, charismatic authority, enemy production, punishment/exit cost and social inheritance.

concrete_families.label: Digital underground, harassment & adversarial subcultures
concrete_families.legal_class: mixed: lawful speech, platform abuse and criminal conduct must be separated
concrete_families.project_role: Shows how attention, archive, pseudonymity, repetition and target production can become a durable subculture/Foundation.

concrete_families.label: Money laundering, terrorist financing & financial concealment
concrete_families.project_role: Money/obligation Roots connecting otherwise separate branches; use risk-based evidence rather than assuming opaque ownership equals crime.

foundation_lens.question: What makes a hidden or harmful system repeatable enough to survive the founder/event?
foundation_lens.insight: Bad seeds can become communities when they acquire a repeatable social platform: identity + recruitment + rules + resources + communication + enforcement + succession. This is the shadow-side analogue of ordinary institutional reproduction.
foundation_lens.boundary: The same reproduction grammar can describe benign communities. Harm must be independently evidenced, not inferred from structural similarity.

upward_flow: Raw signal → provenance → classification → corroboration/counterevidence → mechanism → legal/status determination → consequence → repair/public knowledge. Nothing should rise merely because it is dramatic.

access_visibility_axis.meaning: Access restricted by ordinary role, contract, privacy or need-to-know; not evidence of wrongdoing.
Legitimate restricted information protected by professional, commercial, personal or institutional duty.
State-restricted information under a legal security regime.
Deliberately concealed activity; legality depends on actor, authority and conduct.
Visibility/access state is not yet established.

evidentiary_legal_status_axis.meaning: A claim exists but has not been independently established.
Independent evidence supports material parts of the claim without necessarily establishing legal liability.
A competent body is or was examining conduct; investigation is not guilt.
A formal criminal allegation has been filed in a named jurisdiction.
A court/tribunal or competent adjudicative body issued a finding; retain jurisdiction/date/appeal status.
A criminal conviction exists; retain appeal, reversal, pardon or expiry status where relevant.
A formal designation/classification was issued by a named authority and is time/jurisdiction specific.
A claim, charge or investigation ended without the adverse finding being established; preserve exact procedural meaning.
No reliable current legal/evidentiary status is established.

case_separation_rule.claim: What is asserted about conduct or relationship.
case_separation_rule.relationship: What connection/event is documented between entities.
case_separation_rule.access_state: Who can see the underlying information and under what restriction.
case_separation_rule.evidentiary_status: How well the proposition is supported.
case_separation_rule.legal_status: What a competent authority has formally done or found.
case_separation_rule.interpretation: What the project infers or compares after the factual layers are preserved.

visibility_states_deprecated.note: The former visibility_states array mixed access/visibility with evidentiary/legal status. Use access_visibility_axis and evidentiary_legal_status_axis instead.

retained_for_migration.meaning: Legitimate restricted information; not evidence of wrongdoing.
State-restricted information under a legal security regime.
Deliberately concealed activity; legality depends on actor/context.
Claim exists but is not established.
A competent body is/was examining conduct; not guilt.
Criminal conviction, subject to appeal/reversal status.
Formal designation by a named jurisdiction/authority.

upward_flow_detail.test: Is there an identifiable source, event, document or observation?
Who produced it, when, under what conditions, and is the source authentic?
Is the material public, confidential, classified, clandestine, pseudonymous or unknown?
Separate entity, claim, relationship, case and interpretation before linking them.
What independent evidence supports or contradicts the proposition?
What legal/evidentiary status actually exists, in which jurisdiction and on what date?
What repeatable structure or causal mechanism is supported rather than merely alleged?
What documented harms, protections, outcomes or externalities followed?
What oversight, exit, disruption, adjudication, reform, support or public knowledge can safely return upward?

spatial_model.image: Below is projected as a shallow circular basin/pot beneath World: World-facing rim, culture/subculture surface, Sektur territories, Farm loops, Swamp entanglement, Mud/Ash sediment, Roots/provenance below, inner Forge ring and central Axis/Drain.
spatial_model.rule: Spatial overlap does not erase category distinctions: Below=plane; Swamp=regime; Sektur=territory; Farm=process; Mud/Ash=material; Roots=organism/provenance; Forge=process; Drain=route; Axis=coordinate.
